cat > "$HOME/dnsrecv.py" <<'PYEOF'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, ipaddress, socket, struct, sys, time
TYPES = {1: "A", 2: "NS", 5: "CNAME", 6: "SOA", 15: "MX", 16: "TXT", 28: "AAAA", 41: "OPT", 250: "TSIG", 255: "ANY"}
CLASSES = {1: "IN", 3: "CH", 254: "NONE", 255: "ANY"}
OPCODES = {0: "QUERY", 4: "NOTIFY", 5: "UPDATE"}
RCODES = {"NOERROR": 0, "SERVFAIL": 2, "NXDOMAIN": 3, "REFUSED": 5, "YXDOMAIN": 6, "NOTAUTH": 9}
mode, port, logpath = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
opts = dict(a.split("=", 1) for a in sys.argv[4:])
rcodes = opts.get("rcodes", "NOERROR").split(",")
keyname, key = None, None
if "key" in opts:
    keyname, secretfile = opts["key"].split(":", 1)
    key = base64.b64decode(open(secretfile).read().strip())
wrong = opts.get("sign") == "wrong-key"
unsigned = opts.get("sign") == "none"
log = open(logpath, "w")
def out(line):
    log.write(line + "\n")
    log.flush()
def name(msg, off):
    labels, end = [], None
    for _ in range(128):
        n = msg[off]
        if n & 0xC0 == 0xC0:
            if end is None:
                end = off + 2
            off = ((n & 0x3F) << 8) | msg[off + 1]
            continue
        off += 1
        if n == 0:
            break
        labels.append(msg[off:off + n].decode("ascii", "replace"))
        off += n
    return (".".join(labels) + ".") if labels else ".", (end if end is not None else off)
def wire(text):
    data = b""
    for label in text.rstrip(".").split("."):
        if label:
            data += bytes([len(label)]) + label.lower().encode()
    return data + b"\0"
def parse(msg):
    ident, flags, qd, an, ns, ar = struct.unpack("!6H", msg[:12])
    off, questions = 12, []
    for _ in range(qd):
        owner, off = name(msg, off)
        t, c = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[off:off + 4])
        off += 4
        questions.append((owner, t, c))
    qend, sections = off, []
    for count in (an, ns, ar):
        records = []
        for _ in range(count):
            start = off
            owner, off = name(msg, off)
            t, c, ttl, rdlen = struct.unpack("!HHIH", msg[off:off + 10])
            off += 10
            records.append(dict(owner=owner, type=t, cls=c, ttl=ttl, rdoff=off, rdata=msg[off:off + rdlen], start=start))
            off += rdlen
        sections.append(records)
    return dict(id=ident, flags=flags, questions=questions, qend=qend, an=sections[0], ns=sections[1], ar=sections[2])
def rdata(msg, r):
    t, d = r["type"], r["rdata"]
    if not d:
        return "none"
    if t == 1 and len(d) == 4:
        return str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(d))
    if t == 28 and len(d) == 16:
        return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(d))
    if t in (2, 5):
        return name(msg, r["rdoff"])[0]
    if t == 15:
        return "%d %s" % (struct.unpack("!H", d[:2])[0], name(msg, r["rdoff"] + 2)[0])
    if t == 6:
        _, o = name(msg, r["rdoff"])
        _, o = name(msg, o)
        return "serial=%d" % struct.unpack("!I", msg[o:o + 4])[0]
    return "hex=" + d.hex()
def show(kind, msg, r):
    ttl = "" if kind == "answer" else " ttl=%d" % r["ttl"]
    out("%s %s %s %s%s rdata=%s" % (kind, r["owner"], TYPES.get(r["type"], r["type"]),
                                    CLASSES.get(r["cls"], r["cls"]), ttl, rdata(msg, r)))
def tsig_vars(kname, alg, signed, fudge, error, other):
    return (wire(kname) + struct.pack("!HI", 255, 0) + wire(alg) + signed.to_bytes(6, "big") +
            struct.pack("!HHH", fudge, error, len(other)) + other)
def verify(msg, p):
    records = [r for r in p["ar"] if r["type"] == 250]
    if not records:
        out("tsig=none")
        return None
    r = records[-1]
    alg, o = name(msg, r["rdoff"])
    signed = int.from_bytes(msg[o:o + 6], "big")
    fudge, size = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[o + 6:o + 10])
    mac = msg[o + 10:o + 10 + size]
    o += 10 + size
    origid, error, olen = struct.unpack("!HHH", msg[o:o + 6])
    other = msg[o + 6:o + 6 + olen]
    body = bytearray(msg[:r["start"]])
    struct.pack_into("!H", body, 0, origid)
    struct.pack_into("!H", body, 10, struct.unpack("!H", body[10:12])[0] - 1)
    valid = key is not None and r["owner"].lower() == keyname.lower().rstrip(".") + "." and alg.lower() == "hmac-sha256." and \
        hmac.compare_digest(hmac.new(key, bytes(body) + tsig_vars(r["owner"], alg, signed, fudge, error, other),
                                     hashlib.sha256).digest(), mac)
    out("tsig key=%s alg=%s mac=%s time=%s" % (r["owner"].lower(), alg.lower(), "valid" if valid else "invalid",
                                               "within-fudge" if abs(time.time() - signed) <= fudge else "outside-fudge"))
    return mac
def reply(msg, p, rcode, opcode, reqmac):
    flags = 0x8000 | (opcode << 11) | (0x0400 if opcode == 4 else 0) | RCODES[rcode]
    resp = struct.pack("!6H", p["id"], flags, len(p["questions"]), 0, 0, 0) + msg[12:p["qend"]]
    signed = "no"
    if reqmac is not None and key is not None and not unsigned:
        use = hashlib.sha256(key + b"wrong").digest() if wrong else key
        now, fudge = int(time.time()), 300
        mac = hmac.new(use, struct.pack("!H", len(reqmac)) + reqmac + resp +
                       tsig_vars(keyname, "hmac-sha256.", now, fudge, 0, b""), hashlib.sha256).digest()
        rd = wire("hmac-sha256.") + now.to_bytes(6, "big") + struct.pack("!HH", fudge, len(mac)) + mac + struct.pack("!HHH", p["id"], 0, 0)
        resp = bytearray(resp + wire(keyname) + struct.pack("!HHIH", 250, 255, 0, len(rd)) + rd)
        struct.pack_into("!H", resp, 10, 1)
        resp, signed = bytes(resp), ("wrong-key" if wrong else "yes")
    out("reply rcode=%s signed=%s" % (rcode, signed))
    return resp
def handle(msg, rcode):
    p = parse(msg)
    opcode = (p["flags"] >> 11) & 0xF
    out("message opcode=%s qr=%d aa=%d" % (OPCODES.get(opcode, opcode), p["flags"] >> 15, (p["flags"] >> 10) & 1))
    for owner, t, c in p["questions"]:
        out("%s %s %s %s" % ("zone" if opcode == 5 else "question", owner, TYPES.get(t, t), CLASSES.get(c, c)))
    if opcode == 5:
        for r in p["an"]:
            show("prereq", msg, r)
        for r in p["ns"]:
            show("update", msg, r)
    else:
        for r in p["an"]:
            show("answer", msg, r)
        if not p["an"]:
            out("answer=none")
    return reply(msg, p, rcode, opcode, verify(msg, p))
if mode == "update":
    server = socket.socket()
    server.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
    server.listen(4)
    server.settimeout(8)
    for rcode in rcodes:
        try:
            conn, _ = server.accept()
        except socket.timeout:
            out("timeout waiting for message")
            break
        conn.settimeout(5)
        data = b""
        try:
            while len(data) < 2 or len(data) < 2 + struct.unpack("!H", data[:2])[0]:
                chunk = conn.recv(65536)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                data += chunk
            if len(data) >= 2:
                resp = handle(data[2:2 + struct.unpack("!H", data[:2])[0]], rcode)
                conn.sendall(struct.pack("!H", len(resp)) + resp)
        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, struct.error) as exc:
            out("error %s" % type(exc).__name__)
        conn.close()
else:
    server = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
    server.settimeout(8)
    for rcode in rcodes:
        try:
            msg, peer = server.recvfrom(65536)
        except socket.timeout:
            out("timeout waiting for message")
            break
        try:
            server.sendto(handle(msg, rcode), peer)
        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, struct.error) as exc:
            out("error %s" % type(exc).__name__)

cases.script:
listening() { local _a l _r st _x
  while read -r _a l _r st _x; do [[ $l == 0100007F:$1 && $st == $3 ]] && return 0; done < "/proc/net/$2"
  return 1; }
up() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" tcp 0A && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
uup() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" udp 07 && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
settle() { /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/settle.py" "$$"; }
finish() { local i s
  for ((i = 0; i < 100; i++)); do kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.05; done
  if kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null; then kill "$1"; wait "$1" 2>/dev/null; echo server-still-running; return; fi
  wait "$1"; s=$?
  if [ "$s" = 0 ]; then echo server-stopped; else echo "server-status=$s"; fi; }
q() { echo "== $*"; /usr/bin/dig +norec +tries=1 +time=2 -p "$P" @127.0.0.1 "$@" > "$HOME/dig.out" 2>&1
  /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/dproj.py" "$HOME/dig.out"; }
qr() { echo "== $*"; /usr/bin/dig +tries=1 +time=2 -p "$P" @127.0.0.1 "$@" > "$HOME/dig.out" 2>&1
  /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/dproj.py" "$HOME/dig.out" --no-ttl $DPOPT; }
ax() { echo "== axfr $*"; /usr/bin/dig +tries=1 +time=3 -p "$P" @127.0.0.1 "$@" > "$HOME/axfr.out" 2>&1
  /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/daxfr.py" "$HOME/axfr.out"; }
P=20660
dns auth-serve --zone "$HOME/example.zone" --max-queries 8 --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 20660 </dev/null 2>"$HOME/server.log" & srv=$!
up 50B4 "$srv" || echo server-not-listening
q www.example.test A
q www.example.test AAAA
q example.test MX
q txt.example.test TXT
q alias.example.test A
q missing.example.test A
q www.example.test MX
q example.test SOA
finish "$srv"
settle

listening() { local _a l _r st _x
  while read -r _a l _r st _x; do [[ $l == 0100007F:$1 && $st == $3 ]] && return 0; done < "/proc/net/$2"
  return 1; }
up() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" tcp 0A && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
uup() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" udp 07 && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
settle() { /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/settle.py" "$$"; }
finish() { local i s
  for ((i = 0; i < 100; i++)); do kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.05; done
  if kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null; then kill "$1"; wait "$1" 2>/dev/null; echo server-still-running; return; fi
  wait "$1"; s=$?
  if [ "$s" = 0 ]; then echo server-stopped; else echo "server-status=$s"; fi; }

        try:

    time.sleep(0.05)

    print("unsettled-processes=%d" % len(live))

import os, sys, time
leader, me = int(sys.argv[1]), os.getpid()

    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()

    print("unsettled-processes=%d" % len(live))

listening() { local _a l _r st _x
  while read -r _a l _r st _x; do [[ $l == 0100007F:$1 && $st == $3 ]] && return 0; done < "/proc/net/$2"
  return 1; }
up() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" tcp 0A && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
uup() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do

    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }

  if kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null; then kill "$1"; wait "$1" 2>/dev/null; echo server-still-running; return; fi

import os, sys, time
leader, me = int(sys.argv[1]), os.getpid()
def stat(pid):
    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()
    return data[data.rindex(b")") + 2:].split()
guest = int(stat(leader)[1])
deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
while True:
    live = []
    for entry in os.listdir("/proc"):
        if not entry.isdigit() or int(entry) in (leader, me):
            continue
        try:
            fields = stat(entry)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
        if fields[0] != b"Z" and (int(fields[3]) == leader or int(fields[1]) == guest):
            live.append(entry)
    if not live or time.monotonic() > deadline:
        break
    time.sleep(0.05)
if live:
    print("unsettled-processes=%d" % len(live))

        t, c = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[off:off + 4])
        off += 4
        questions.append((owner, t, c))

            off += 10

    if t == 28 and len(d) == 16:

import base64, hashlib, hmac, ipaddress, socket, struct, sys, time
TYPES = {1: "A", 2: "NS", 5: "CNAME", 6: "SOA", 15: "MX", 16: "TXT", 28: "AAAA", 41: "OPT", 250: "TSIG", 255: "ANY"}
CLASSES = {1: "IN", 3: "CH", 254: "NONE", 255: "ANY"}
OPCODES = {0: "QUERY", 4: "NOTIFY", 5: "UPDATE"}
RCODES = {"NOERROR": 0, "SERVFAIL": 2, "NXDOMAIN": 3, "REFUSED": 5, "YXDOMAIN": 6, "NOTAUTH": 9}
mode, port, logpath = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
opts = dict(a.split("=", 1) for a in sys.argv[4:])
rcodes = opts.get("rcodes", "NOERROR").split(",")
keyname, key = None, None
if "key" in opts:
    keyname, secretfile = opts["key"].split(":", 1)
    key = base64.b64decode(open(secretfile).read().strip())
wrong = opts.get("sign") == "wrong-key"
unsigned = opts.get("sign") == "none"
log = open(logpath, "w")
def out(line):
    log.write(line + "\n")
    log.flush()
def name(msg, off):
    labels, end = [], None
    for _ in range(128):
        n = msg[off]
        if n & 0xC0 == 0xC0:
            if end is None:
                end = off + 2
            off = ((n & 0x3F) << 8) | msg[off + 1]
            continue
        off += 1
        if n == 0:
            break
        labels.append(msg[off:off + n].decode("ascii", "replace"))
        off += n
    return (".".join(labels) + ".") if labels else ".", (end if end is not None else off)
def wire(text):
    data = b""
    for label in text.rstrip(".").split("."):
        if label:
            data += bytes([len(label)]) + label.lower().encode()
    return data + b"\0"
def parse(msg):
    ident, flags, qd, an, ns, ar = struct.unpack("!6H", msg[:12])
    off, questions = 12, []
    for _ in range(qd):
        owner, off = name(msg, off)
        t, c = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[off:off + 4])
        off += 4
        questions.append((owner, t, c))
    qend, sections = off, []
    for count in (an, ns, ar):
        records = []
        for _ in range(count):
            start = off
            owner, off = name(msg, off)
            t, c, ttl, rdlen = struct.unpack("!HHIH", msg[off:off + 10])
            off += 10
            records.append(dict(owner=owner, type=t, cls=c, ttl=ttl, rdoff=off, rdata=msg[off:off + rdlen], start=start))
            off += rdlen
        sections.append(records)
    return dict(id=ident, flags=flags, questions=questions, qend=qend, an=sections[0], ns=sections[1], ar=sections[2])
def rdata(msg, r):
    t, d = r["type"], r["rdata"]
    if not d:
        return "none"
    if t == 1 and len(d) == 4:
        return str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(d))
    if t == 28 and len(d) == 16:
        return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(d))
    if t in (2, 5):
        return name(msg, r["rdoff"])[0]
    if t == 15:
        return "%d %s" % (struct.unpack("!H", d[:2])[0], name(msg, r["rdoff"] + 2)[0])
    if t == 6:
        _, o = name(msg, r["rdoff"])
        _, o = name(msg, o)
        return "serial=%d" % struct.unpack("!I", msg[o:o + 4])[0]
    return "hex=" + d.hex()
def show(kind, msg, r):
    ttl = "" if kind == "answer" else " ttl=%d" % r["ttl"]
    out("%s %s %s %s%s rdata=%s" % (kind, r["owner"], TYPES.get(r["type"], r["type"]),
                                    CLASSES.get(r["cls"], r["cls"]), ttl, rdata(msg, r)))
def tsig_vars(kname, alg, signed, fudge, error, other):
    return (wire(kname) + struct.pack("!HI", 255, 0) + wire(alg) + signed.to_bytes(6, "big") +
            struct.pack("!HHH", fudge, error, len(other)) + other)
def verify(msg, p):
    records = [r for r in p["ar"] if r["type"] == 250]
    if not records:
        out("tsig=none")
        return None
    r = records[-1]
    alg, o = name(msg, r["rdoff"])
    signed = int.from_bytes(msg[o:o + 6], "big")
    fudge, size = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[o + 6:o + 10])
    mac = msg[o + 10:o + 10 + size]
    o += 10 + size
    origid, error, olen = struct.unpack("!HHH", msg[o:o + 6])
    other = msg[o + 6:o + 6 + olen]
    body = bytearray(msg[:r["start"]])
    struct.pack_into("!H", body, 0, origid)
    struct.pack_into("!H", body, 10, struct.unpack("!H", body[10:12])[0] - 1)
    valid = key is not None and r["owner"].lower() == keyname.lower().rstrip(".") + "." and alg.lower() == "hmac-sha256." and \

    out("tsig key=%s alg=%s mac=%s time=%s" % (r["owner"].lower(), alg.lower(), "valid" if valid else "invalid",

    signed = "no"

        use = hashlib.sha256(key + b"wrong").digest() if wrong else key
        now, fudge = int(time.time()), 300

                       tsig_vars(keyname, "hmac-sha256.", now, fudge, 0, b""), hashlib.sha256).digest()
        rd = wire("hmac-sha256.") + now.to_bytes(6, "big") + struct.pack("!HH", fudge, len(mac)) + mac + struct.pack("!HHH", p["id"], 0, 0)
        resp = bytearray(resp + wire(keyname) + struct.pack("!HHIH", 250, 255, 0, len(rd)) + rd)
        struct.pack_into("!H", resp, 10, 1)
        resp, signed = bytes(resp), ("wrong-key" if wrong else "yes")
    out("reply rcode=%s signed=%s" % (rcode, signed))
    return resp

    p = parse(msg)
    opcode = (p["flags"] >> 11) & 0xF
    out("message opcode=%s qr=%d aa=%d" % (OPCODES.get(opcode, opcode), p["flags"] >> 15, (p["flags"] >> 10) & 1))
    for owner, t, c in p["questions"]:
        out("%s %s %s %s" % ("zone" if opcode == 5 else "question", owner, TYPES.get(t, t), CLASSES.get(c, c)))

        for r in p["an"]:
            show("prereq", msg, r)
        for r in p["ns"]:
            show("update", msg, r)
    else:
        for r in p["an"]:
            show("answer", msg, r)
        if not p["an"]:
            out("answer=none")

    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))

    server.settimeout(8)

        except socket.timeout:

            break

        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, struct.error) as exc:
            out("error %s" % type(exc).__name__)

listening() { local _a l _r st _x
  while read -r _a l _r st _x; do [[ $l == 0100007F:$1 && $st == $3 ]] && return 0; done < "/proc/net/$2"
  return 1; }
up() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" tcp 0A && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
uup() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" udp 07 && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
settle() { /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/settle.py" "$$"; }
finish() { local i s
  for ((i = 0; i < 100; i++)); do kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.05; done
  if kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null; then kill "$1"; wait "$1" 2>/dev/null; echo server-still-running; return; fi
  wait "$1"; s=$?

import os, sys, time
leader, me = int(sys.argv[1]), os.getpid()
def stat(pid):
    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()
    return data[data.rindex(b")") + 2:].split()
guest = int(stat(leader)[1])
deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
while True:
    live = []
    for entry in os.listdir("/proc"):
        if not entry.isdigit() or int(entry) in (leader, me):
            continue
        try:
            fields = stat(entry)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
        if fields[0] != b"Z" and (int(fields[3]) == leader or int(fields[1]) == guest):
            live.append(entry)
    if not live or time.monotonic() > deadline:
        break
    time.sleep(0.05)
if live:
    print("unsettled-processes=%d" % len(live))

    sys.exit(0)

        if nottl and len(fields) > 1 and fields[1].isdigit():

        sections[current].append(" ".join(fields))

    print("answer " + record)

    for record in sections.get("AUTHORITY", []):
        print("authority " + record)

cases.script:
listening() { local _a l _r st _x
  while read -r _a l _r st _x; do [[ $l == 0100007F:$1 && $st == $3 ]] && return 0; done < "/proc/net/$2"
  return 1; }
up() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" tcp 0A && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
uup() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" udp 07 && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
settle() { /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/settle.py" "$$"; }
finish() { local i s
  for ((i = 0; i < 100; i++)); do kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.05; done
  if kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null; then kill "$1"; wait "$1" 2>/dev/null; echo server-still-running; return; fi
  wait "$1"; s=$?
  if [ "$s" = 0 ]; then echo server-stopped; else echo "server-status=$s"; fi; }
q() { echo "== $*"; /usr/bin/dig +norec +tries=1 +time=2 -p "$P" @127.0.0.1 "$@" > "$HOME/dig.out" 2>&1
  /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/dproj.py" "$HOME/dig.out"; }
qr() { echo "== $*"; /usr/bin/dig +tries=1 +time=2 -p "$P" @127.0.0.1 "$@" > "$HOME/dig.out" 2>&1

import os, sys, time
leader, me = int(sys.argv[1]), os.getpid()
def stat(pid):
    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()
    return data[data.rindex(b")") + 2:].split()
guest = int(stat(leader)[1])
deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
while True:
    live = []
    for entry in os.listdir("/proc"):
        if not entry.isdigit() or int(entry) in (leader, me):
            continue
        try:
            fields = stat(entry)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
        if fields[0] != b"Z" and (int(fields[3]) == leader or int(fields[1]) == guest):
            live.append(entry)
    if not live or time.monotonic() > deadline:
        break
    time.sleep(0.05)
if live:
    print("unsettled-processes=%d" % len(live))

listening() { local _a l _r st _x
  while read -r _a l _r st _x; do [[ $l == 0100007F:$1 && $st == $3 ]] && return 0; done < "/proc/net/$2"
  return 1; }
up() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" tcp 0A && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
uup() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" udp 07 && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
settle() { /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/settle.py" "$$"; }
finish() { local i s
  for ((i = 0; i < 100; i++)); do kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.05; done
  if kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null; then kill "$1"; wait "$1" 2>/dev/null; echo server-still-running; return; fi
  wait "$1"; s=$?
  if [ "$s" = 0 ]; then echo server-stopped; else echo "server-status=$s"; fi; }
q() { echo "== $*"; /usr/bin/dig +norec +tries=1 +time=2 -p "$P" @127.0.0.1 "$@" > "$HOME/dig.out" 2>&1

leader, me = int(sys.argv[1]), os.getpid()
def stat(pid):
    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:

        try:

            live.append(entry)

listening() { local _a l _r st _x
  while read -r _a l _r st _x; do [[ $l == 0100007F:$1 && $st == $3 ]] && return 0; done < "/proc/net/$2"
  return 1; }
up() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do

    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }

  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do

cases.script:
listening() { local _a l _r st _x
  while read -r _a l _r st _x; do [[ $l == 0100007F:$1 && $st == $3 ]] && return 0; done < "/proc/net/$2"
  return 1; }
up() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" tcp 0A && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
uup() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" udp 07 && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
settle() { /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/settle.py" "$$"; }
finish() { local i s
  for ((i = 0; i < 100; i++)); do kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.05; done
  if kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null; then kill "$1"; wait "$1" 2>/dev/null; echo server-still-running; return; fi
  wait "$1"; s=$?
  if [ "$s" = 0 ]; then echo server-stopped; else echo "server-status=$s"; fi; }
q() { echo "== $*"; /usr/bin/dig +norec +tries=1 +time=2 -p "$P" @127.0.0.1 "$@" > "$HOME/dig.out" 2>&1
  /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/dproj.py" "$HOME/dig.out"; }
qr() { echo "== $*"; /usr/bin/dig +tries=1 +time=2 -p "$P" @127.0.0.1 "$@" > "$HOME/dig.out" 2>&1
  /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/dproj.py" "$HOME/dig.out" --no-ttl $DPOPT; }

  /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/daxfr.py" "$HOME/axfr.out"; }

export BASHDNS_0X20=0

cases.oracle: Candidate-only contract: dig (RD=1) is the client; only the QR/RA/RD flags are projected (RFC 1035 4.1.1: RD is copied into the response; RA set by a recursive server) except where AA is the obligation; the upstream is network.py's RFC 1035 dns peer, which records each forwarded query. Expected answers come from that peer's zone; cache behaviour per dns_doc (bounded TTL cache, negative answers cached per RFC 2308) and RFC 6147 DNS64 synthesis. TTLs are not projected because a cache legitimately decrements them. BASHDNS_0X20=0 (documented hook) keeps the recorded upstream qnames comparable.
cases.comparison: contract: --dns64 64:ff9b::/96 synthesizes AAAA from the A of a v4-only name (RFC 6147 5.1.7: 192.0.2.53 -> 64:ff9b::c000:235) after an AAAA then A upstream query, and leaves a native AAAA alone

import os, sys, time
leader, me = int(sys.argv[1]), os.getpid()
def stat(pid):
    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()
    return data[data.rindex(b")") + 2:].split()
guest = int(stat(leader)[1])
deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
while True:
    live = []
    for entry in os.listdir("/proc"):
        if not entry.isdigit() or int(entry) in (leader, me):
            continue
        try:
            fields = stat(entry)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
        if fields[0] != b"Z" and (int(fields[3]) == leader or int(fields[1]) == guest):
            live.append(entry)
    if not live or time.monotonic() > deadline:
        break
    time.sleep(0.05)
if live:
    print("unsettled-processes=%d" % len(live))

import os, sys, time
leader, me = int(sys.argv[1]), os.getpid()
def stat(pid):
    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()
    return data[data.rindex(b")") + 2:].split()
guest = int(stat(leader)[1])
deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
while True:
    live = []
    for entry in os.listdir("/proc"):
        if not entry.isdigit() or int(entry) in (leader, me):
            continue
        try:
            fields = stat(entry)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
        if fields[0] != b"Z" and (int(fields[3]) == leader or int(fields[1]) == guest):
            live.append(entry)
    if not live or time.monotonic() > deadline:
        break
    time.sleep(0.05)
if live:
    print("unsettled-processes=%d" % len(live))

cat > "$HOME/dnsrecv.py" <<'PYEOF'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, ipaddress, socket, struct, sys, time
TYPES = {1: "A", 2: "NS", 5: "CNAME", 6: "SOA", 15: "MX", 16: "TXT", 28: "AAAA", 41: "OPT", 250: "TSIG", 255: "ANY"}
CLASSES = {1: "IN", 3: "CH", 254: "NONE", 255: "ANY"}
OPCODES = {0: "QUERY", 4: "NOTIFY", 5: "UPDATE"}
RCODES = {"NOERROR": 0, "SERVFAIL": 2, "NXDOMAIN": 3, "REFUSED": 5, "YXDOMAIN": 6, "NOTAUTH": 9}
mode, port, logpath = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
opts = dict(a.split("=", 1) for a in sys.argv[4:])
rcodes = opts.get("rcodes", "NOERROR").split(",")
keyname, key = None, None
if "key" in opts:
    keyname, secretfile = opts["key"].split(":", 1)
    key = base64.b64decode(open(secretfile).read().strip())
wrong = opts.get("sign") == "wrong-key"
unsigned = opts.get("sign") == "none"
log = open(logpath, "w")
def out(line):
    log.write(line + "\n")
    log.flush()
def name(msg, off):
    labels, end = [], None
    for _ in range(128):
        n = msg[off]
        if n & 0xC0 == 0xC0:
            if end is None:
                end = off + 2
            off = ((n & 0x3F) << 8) | msg[off + 1]
            continue
        off += 1
        if n == 0:
            break
        labels.append(msg[off:off + n].decode("ascii", "replace"))
        off += n
    return (".".join(labels) + ".") if labels else ".", (end if end is not None else off)
def wire(text):
    data = b""
    for label in text.rstrip(".").split("."):
        if label:
            data += bytes([len(label)]) + label.lower().encode()
    return data + b"\0"
def parse(msg):
    ident, flags, qd, an, ns, ar = struct.unpack("!6H", msg[:12])
    off, questions = 12, []
    for _ in range(qd):
        owner, off = name(msg, off)
        t, c = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[off:off + 4])
        off += 4
        questions.append((owner, t, c))
    qend, sections = off, []
    for count in (an, ns, ar):
        records = []
        for _ in range(count):
            start = off
            owner, off = name(msg, off)
            t, c, ttl, rdlen = struct.unpack("!HHIH", msg[off:off + 10])
            off += 10
            records.append(dict(owner=owner, type=t, cls=c, ttl=ttl, rdoff=off, rdata=msg[off:off + rdlen], start=start))
            off += rdlen
        sections.append(records)
    return dict(id=ident, flags=flags, questions=questions, qend=qend, an=sections[0], ns=sections[1], ar=sections[2])
def rdata(msg, r):
    t, d = r["type"], r["rdata"]
    if not d:
        return "none"
    if t == 1 and len(d) == 4:
        return str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(d))
    if t == 28 and len(d) == 16:
        return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(d))
    if t in (2, 5):
        return name(msg, r["rdoff"])[0]
    if t == 15:
        return "%d %s" % (struct.unpack("!H", d[:2])[0], name(msg, r["rdoff"] + 2)[0])
    if t == 6:
        _, o = name(msg, r["rdoff"])
        _, o = name(msg, o)
        return "serial=%d" % struct.unpack("!I", msg[o:o + 4])[0]
    return "hex=" + d.hex()
def show(kind, msg, r):
    ttl = "" if kind == "answer" else " ttl=%d" % r["ttl"]
    out("%s %s %s %s%s rdata=%s" % (kind, r["owner"], TYPES.get(r["type"], r["type"]),
                                    CLASSES.get(r["cls"], r["cls"]), ttl, rdata(msg, r)))
def tsig_vars(kname, alg, signed, fudge, error, other):
    return (wire(kname) + struct.pack("!HI", 255, 0) + wire(alg) + signed.to_bytes(6, "big") +
            struct.pack("!HHH", fudge, error, len(other)) + other)
def verify(msg, p):
    records = [r for r in p["ar"] if r["type"] == 250]
    if not records:
        out("tsig=none")
        return None
    r = records[-1]
    alg, o = name(msg, r["rdoff"])
    signed = int.from_bytes(msg[o:o + 6], "big")
    fudge, size = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[o + 6:o + 10])
    mac = msg[o + 10:o + 10 + size]
    o += 10 + size
    origid, error, olen = struct.unpack("!HHH", msg[o:o + 6])
    other = msg[o + 6:o + 6 + olen]
    body = bytearray(msg[:r["start"]])
    struct.pack_into("!H", body, 0, origid)
    struct.pack_into("!H", body, 10, struct.unpack("!H", body[10:12])[0] - 1)
    valid = key is not None and r["owner"].lower() == keyname.lower().rstrip(".") + "." and alg.lower() == "hmac-sha256." and \
        hmac.compare_digest(hmac.new(key, bytes(body) + tsig_vars(r["owner"], alg, signed, fudge, error, other),
                                     hashlib.sha256).digest(), mac)
    out("tsig key=%s alg=%s mac=%s time=%s" % (r["owner"].lower(), alg.lower(), "valid" if valid else "invalid",
                                               "within-fudge" if abs(time.time() - signed) <= fudge else "outside-fudge"))
    return mac
def reply(msg, p, rcode, opcode, reqmac):
    flags = 0x8000 | (opcode << 11) | (0x0400 if opcode == 4 else 0) | RCODES[rcode]
    resp = struct.pack("!6H", p["id"], flags, len(p["questions"]), 0, 0, 0) + msg[12:p["qend"]]
    signed = "no"
    if reqmac is not None and key is not None and not unsigned:
        use = hashlib.sha256(key + b"wrong").digest() if wrong else key
        now, fudge = int(time.time()), 300
        mac = hmac.new(use, struct.pack("!H", len(reqmac)) + reqmac + resp +
                       tsig_vars(keyname, "hmac-sha256.", now, fudge, 0, b""), hashlib.sha256).digest()

        resp = bytearray(resp + wire(keyname) + struct.pack("!HHIH", 250, 255, 0, len(rd)) + rd)
        struct.pack_into("!H", resp, 10, 1)
        resp, signed = bytes(resp), ("wrong-key" if wrong else "yes")
    out("reply rcode=%s signed=%s" % (rcode, signed))
    return resp

    p = parse(msg)
    opcode = (p["flags"] >> 11) & 0xF
    out("message opcode=%s qr=%d aa=%d" % (OPCODES.get(opcode, opcode), p["flags"] >> 15, (p["flags"] >> 10) & 1))
    for owner, t, c in p["questions"]:
        out("%s %s %s %s" % ("zone" if opcode == 5 else "question", owner, TYPES.get(t, t), CLASSES.get(c, c)))
    if opcode == 5:
        for r in p["an"]:
            show("prereq", msg, r)
        for r in p["ns"]:
            show("update", msg, r)
    else:
        for r in p["an"]:
            show("answer", msg, r)
        if not p["an"]:
            out("answer=none")
    return reply(msg, p, rcode, opcode, verify(msg, p))
if mode == "update":
    server = socket.socket()
    server.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
    server.listen(4)
    server.settimeout(8)
    for rcode in rcodes:
        try:
            conn, _ = server.accept()
        except socket.timeout:
            out("timeout waiting for message")
            break
        conn.settimeout(5)
        data = b""
        try:
            while len(data) < 2 or len(data) < 2 + struct.unpack("!H", data[:2])[0]:
                chunk = conn.recv(65536)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                data += chunk
            if len(data) >= 2:
                resp = handle(data[2:2 + struct.unpack("!H", data[:2])[0]], rcode)
                conn.sendall(struct.pack("!H", len(resp)) + resp)
        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, struct.error) as exc:
            out("error %s" % type(exc).__name__)
        conn.close()
else:
    server = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    server.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
    server.settimeout(8)
    for rcode in rcodes:
        try:
            msg, peer = server.recvfrom(65536)
        except socket.timeout:
            out("timeout waiting for message")
            break
        try:
            server.sendto(handle(msg, rcode), peer)
        except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError, struct.error) as exc:
            out("error %s" % type(exc).__name__)

CLASSES = {1: "IN", 3: "CH", 254: "NONE", 255: "ANY"}
OPCODES = {0: "QUERY", 4: "NOTIFY", 5: "UPDATE"}

    log.write(line + "\n")
    log.flush()

    labels, end = [], None

                end = off + 2
            off = ((n & 0x3F) << 8) | msg[off + 1]
            continue
        off += 1
        if n == 0:
            break

        off += n

        t, c = struct.unpack("!HH", msg[off:off + 4])
        off += 4
        questions.append((owner, t, c))
    qend, sections = off, []

            owner, off = name(msg, off)

            off += 10

    if t == 28 and len(d) == 16:

        for r in p["ns"]:

    else:

        except socket.timeout:

    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()
    return data[data.rindex(b")") + 2:].split()

        try:

            continue
        if fields[0] != b"Z" and (int(fields[3]) == leader or int(fields[1]) == guest):
            live.append(entry)

        break
    time.sleep(0.05)

    print("unsettled-processes=%d" % len(live))

cases.script:
listening() { local _a l _r st _x
  while read -r _a l _r st _x; do [[ $l == 0100007F:$1 && $st == $3 ]] && return 0; done < "/proc/net/$2"
  return 1; }
up() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" tcp 0A && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
uup() { local i
  for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
    listening "$1" udp 07 && return 0
    kill -0 "$2" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1; }
settle() { /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/settle.py" "$$"; }
finish() { local i s
  for ((i = 0; i < 100; i++)); do kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.05; done
  if kill -0 "$1" 2>/dev/null; then kill "$1"; wait "$1" 2>/dev/null; echo server-still-running; return; fi
  wait "$1"; s=$?
  if [ "$s" = 0 ]; then echo server-stopped; else echo "server-status=$s"; fi; }
q() { echo "== $*"; /usr/bin/dig +norec +tries=1 +time=2 -p "$P" @127.0.0.1 "$@" > "$HOME/dig.out" 2>&1
  /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/dproj.py" "$HOME/dig.out"; }
qr() { echo "== $*"; /usr/bin/dig +tries=1 +time=2 -p "$P" @127.0.0.1 "$@" > "$HOME/dig.out" 2>&1
  /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/dproj.py" "$HOME/dig.out" --no-ttl $DPOPT; }
ax() { echo "== axfr $*"; /usr/bin/dig +tries=1 +time=3 -p "$P" @127.0.0.1 "$@" > "$HOME/axfr.out" 2>&1
  /usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/daxfr.py" "$HOME/axfr.out"; }
/usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/dnsrecv.py" notify 20665 "$HOME/recv.log" key=fixture-key:$HOME/tsig.secret sign=none & rcv=$!
uup 50B9 "$rcv" || echo receiver-not-listening
ACKONLY=1
o=$(dns notify --zone example.test --to 127.0.0.1:20665 --timeout 2000 --retries 0 --tsig-key "fixture-key:hmac-sha256:$(<"$HOME/tsig.secret")" 2>/dev/null)
rc=$?
if [ -n "$ACKONLY" ]; then [[ $o == *" ack"* ]] && echo reported-ack || echo not-reported-ack
elif [[ $o == *no-response* ]]; then echo reported-no-response; elif [[ $o == *ack* ]]; then echo reported-ack; else echo reported-other; fi
if [ "$rc" = 0 ]; then echo status=0; else echo status=nonzero; fi
wait "$rcv"; echo "receiver=$?"
printf '%s\n' "$(<"$HOME/recv.log")"
settle
